prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have real‑time listings, so I can’t name a single current “best” salon in Charlotte — that can change by neighborhood, your tanning preference, and recent reviews. I can help you find the best one for you if you tell me whether you want UV (beds) or sunless (spray/airbrush), roughly what area/zip code of Charlotte, and your budget. 

Until then, here are practical tips and quick options to find the best salon:

What to decide first
- UV tanning (beds) vs sunless spray/airbrush: spray is safer for skin cancer risk; UV gives a deeper “natural” tan but increases cancer/aging risk.  
- Budget: single sessions, packages, or memberships.  
- Convenience: proximity to home/work and hours.

How to identify the best salon
- Check Google and Yelp for salons near your zip code; sort by rating and recent reviews (last 6–12 months).  
- Look for photos of the salon and staff; clean equipment and private spray booths are good signs.  
- Read reviews for consistency (service, cleanliness, results). Single 5‑star reviews aren’t as informative as many recent positive reviews.  
- Verify staff training and certifications for spray tans (airbrush technique, solution brands).  
- Ask what equipment they use (newer lamps, bed maintenance), solution brands, and if they do patch tests for spray tans.  
- Confirm cancellation policy, tanning packages, and discounts for first-timers.

Trusted chain options to check (often have multiple Charlotte locations)
- Palm Beach Tan — widespread, consistent standards and multiple locations.  
- Planet Beach / automated spa chains — convenient for memberships and 24/7 access where available.

Red flags to avoid
- Dirty or poorly maintained beds/rooms.  
- No skin assessment or pressure to buy big packages.  
- No option to see sample photos or do a patch test for spray tans.  
- Very low prices with lots of negative cleanliness/service reviews.

If you tell me:
- UV or spray preference, and
- Your neighborhood or ZIP code (e.g., South End, Uptown, Matthews, 28202, 28203, etc.)

I’ll give tailored salon recommendations and sample places to call/book.
